excerpt: Model accurate commercial janitorial budgets for a 1,500 sq ft single-suite office where two restrooms and mixed flooring drive quote variance. Compare 0, 1, and 2 restroom scenarios alongside weekly, 3x/week, and 5x/week schedules.
quickAnswer: The cost to clean a 1,500 sq ft office with two restrooms on commercial carpet averages $224 to $384 per visit ($972 to $1,663 per month) weekly, $201 to $345 per visit ($2,613 to $4,485 per month) at 3x/week, and $192 to $330 per visit ($4,157 to $7,144 per month) for daily 5x/week weekday care. Restroom counts shift pricing by $15 to $30 per fixture per visit, while hard floors add up to 12% over carpet.

blocks.text: Once an office reaches 1,500 sq ft—typical for an eight-to-twelve person engineering firm, regional insurance branch, or multi-provider wellness clinic—two operational shifts happen simultaneously. First, most commercial suites cross from a single unisex restroom into **two separate ADA-compliant restrooms** ($30 to $60 per visit in combined restroom labor). Second, layouts split into distinct floor zones: hard-surface reception entries, carpeted work bays, ceramic-tiled restrooms, and a dedicated kitchenette.

Because 1,500 sq ft remains inside the **Under 2,500 sq ft** pricing bracket (**$0.12 to $0.20 per sq ft** base rate), restroom counts, floor-care transitions, and weekly schedule frequency determine whether your monthly contract sits near $970 or climbs past $5,800.
1,500 Sq Ft Office Cleaning Cost by Service Frequency

Using our [2026 US pricing benchmarks](/office-cleaning-cost-guides/) (1.00x national baseline, commercial carpet 1.00x, and **two private restrooms**), raising visit frequency trims per-visit unit costs from **$260–$444** on a monthly schedule (1.28x) down to **$192–$330** on a daily weekday schedule (0.90x). Monthly totals apply the exact **4.333 weeks/month** calendar multiplier (4.33 in our calculator engine: 13.0 visits/month for 3x/week and 21.65 visits/month for 5x/week).

blocks.text: The Two-Restroom Inflection Point: 0 vs. 1 vs. 2 Restrooms

Plumbing fixtures are the fastest way two identical 1,500 sq ft suites diverge in janitorial bids. Each commercial restroom adds **$15 to $30 per visit** to cover toilet bowl descaling, urinal sanitation, chrome fixture polishing, mirror detailing, partition wiping, and hospital-grade disinfectant dwell times.

On a **weekly (1x/week)** carpeted contract, a 1,500 sq ft suite with **0 private restrooms** (common-corridor landlord baths) averages **$194 to $324 per visit** (**$842 to $1,403 per month**). Adding **1 restroom** raises weekly quotes to **$209 to $354 per visit** (**$907 to $1,533 per month**), and **2 private restrooms** brings the weekly total to **$224 to $384 per visit** (**$972 to $1,663 per month**)—a spread of up to **$260 per month** on weekly service or **$780 per month** at 3x/week strictly from plumbing count.

blocks.title: Verify Multi-Stall vs. Single-Occupancy Restrooms in RFPs
blocks.text: If one of your two restrooms contains two or three stalls and dual sinks, contractors count fixtures rather than doorways. State exact toilet, urinal, and sink counts in your RFP so bidders do not re-price restrooms after walkthrough.
Flooring Mix and Recurring Add-On Costs at 1,500 Sq Ft

Most 1,500 sq ft suites combine carpeted private offices with LVT reception floors or hardwood conference areas (1.05x mixed flooring multiplier), requiring technicians to transition between HEPA vacuuming and neutral-pH damp mopping during every visit. Stepping up to full **ceramic tile and grout (1.12x)** adds **$267 to $445 per month** over carpet at 3x/week, while adding breakroom care (**$12–$25/visit**), interior glass (**$15–$35/visit**), consumables (**$18–$37.50/visit**), and quarterly deep floor restoration (**$45–$90/mo**) pushes 3x/week totals to **$246 to $442 per visit** (**$3,243 to $5,842 per month**).

blocks.text: Production Speed, Labor Hours, and Multi-Zone Equipment

At ISSA commercial averages (**2,800 to 4,000 sq ft/hr** plus **0.15 to 0.25 hours per restroom**), two restrooms alone consume **18 to 30 minutes** of dedicated scrubbing and fixture disinfection, while vacuuming and damp mopping 1,500 sq ft requires another 25 to 35 minutes. Contractors assign **1.00 to 1.25 billed labor hours per visit**, yielding an implied rate of **$161 to $345 per hour** at 3x/week—or **$35 to $65 per hour** when billed purely on an hourly day-porter model (plus **$55 to $95/hr** for quarterly VCT scrub-and-recoat or biohazard sanitization).
High-output crews handle mixed carpet and hard-floor zones in a 1,500 sq ft suite smoothly by pairing microfiber flat mops with ergonomic commercial backpack vacuums:

**Sanitaire SC412A Commercial Backpack Vacuum:** Combines a generous 10 qt bag capacity and Sealed HEPA filtration with an 11.5 lb chassis and 68 dBA output for thorough single-pass dust pickup.

**Oreck Commercial Pro6A Backpack Vacuum:** Offers a 6 qt bag, Micro-Filter capture, 10.5 lb lightweight profile, and 67 dBA sound rating well suited for multi-room suites and adjacent entry stairwells.

blocks.title: Restroom Compliance: OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens & Color-Coded Microfiber
blocks.text: In a two-restroom office, require vendors to use red color-coded microfiber cloths exclusively inside restrooms (never on breakroom or reception counters) and maintain OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) PPE and HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS binders on-site.
5 Procurement Checks Before Signing a 1,500 Sq Ft Contract
Protect your operating budget by auditing these five contract details before award.

items.name: Itemize Restroom Fixtures and Dwell-Time Standards
items.text: List total toilets, urinals, and sinks alongside EPA List N disinfectant dwell times so two restrooms receive full sanitation rather than quick wipe-downs.

items.name: Define Hard-Floor vs. Carpet Transition Care
items.text: Specify neutral-pH damp mopping on LVT/wood lobbies and HEPA vacuuming on carpet tiles; exclude periodic VCT waxing unless amortized quarterly ($0.03–$0.06/sq ft/mo).

items.name: Verify 4.333 Weeks/Month Retainer Math
items.text: Ensure 3x/week contracts cover 13.0 visits/month and 5x/week contracts cover 21.65 visits/month with clear holiday make-up policies.

items.name: Confirm COI and Fidelity Bond Endorsements
items.text: Collect proof of $1M/$2M General Liability (Additional Insured), statutory Workers' Compensation, and employee dishonesty bonding prior to start.

faqs.q: How much does it cost per month to clean a 1,500 sq ft office with two restrooms?
faqs.a: At US national average rates on commercial carpet, two-restroom suites average $972 to $1,663/month weekly (1x/week), $2,613 to $4,485/month at 3x/week (13.0 visits/mo), and $4,157 to $7,144/month for daily 5x/week weekday maintenance (21.65 visits/mo).

faqs.q: How much does each restroom add to a 1,500 sq ft office cleaning quote?
faqs.a: Each commercial restroom typically adds $15 to $30 per visit. For a 1,500 sq ft weekly contract, moving from 0 to 2 restrooms lifts the per-visit cost from $194–$324 up to $224–$384 ($842–$1,403/mo vs. $972–$1,663/mo).

faqs.q: What is usually excluded from standard 1,500 sq ft janitorial bids?
faqs.a: Standard bids exclude quarterly hot-water carpet extraction, VCT floor stripping and recoating, interior window/partition detailing, inside-refrigerator cleanouts, high dusting above 8 to 10 feet, paper/soap consumables ($0.012–$0.025/sq ft/visit), and OSHA biohazard remediation.

faqs.q: Are Green Seal GS-37 chemicals worth requesting for a 1,500 sq ft suite?
faqs.a: Yes. Green Seal GS-37 and EPA Safer Choice concentrates typically add only 0% to 4% to monthly contracts while protecting employees from harsh chemical fumes across multi-room HVAC zones.

faqs.q: What insurance and OSHA documentation should a 1,500 sq ft cleaning vendor carry?
faqs.a: Require a Certificate of Insurance showing $1M/$2M General Liability naming your firm and landlord as Additional Insured, statutory Workers' Compensation for W-2 cleaners, a fidelity bond, OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) SDS sheets, and OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) training for restroom sanitation.
